jp: 友[とも]だち{と|to-with}{なら|nara-conditional}、どこ{でも|demo-any}楽[たの]しいです。
why: A question word plus でも means 'any', so どこでも is 'anywhere at all'.

jp: この映画[えいが]{は|wa-topic}、どの年齢[ねんれい]{の|no-possessive}人[ひと]{でも|demo-any}楽[たの]しめます。
en: People of any age can enjoy this movie.
why: どの年齢の人 plus でも means 'whichever age group', so everyone is included.

jp: 意見[いけん]{は|wa-topic}、何[なん]{でも|demo-any}言[い]ってください。
en: Please say whatever opinions you have.
why: 何 plus でも means 'anything', so you may say any opinion at all.

jp: 彼女[かのじょ]{は|wa-topic}、どんな話[はなし]{でも|demo-any}まじめに聞[き]いてくれます。
en: She listens seriously to any kind of story.
why: どんな話 plus でも means 'whatever kind of story', with no exception.

jp: 家族[かぞく]{の|no-possessive}ため{なら|nara-conditional}、何[なん]{でも|demo-any}します。
en: For my family I would do anything.
why: 何 plus でも means 'anything at all', so there is nothing I would refuse.

jp: 会議[かいぎ]{の|no-possessive}時間[じかん]{は|wa-topic}、いつ{でも|demo-any}構[かま]いません。
en: Any time is fine for the meeting.
why: いつ plus でも means 'whenever', so every time is acceptable.
